['Novartis Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Novartis AG is a Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation based in Basel, Switzerland. It is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world and manufactures a wide range of drugs including clozapine, diclofenac, carbamazepine, valsartan, imatinib mesylate, cyclosporine, letrozole, methylphenidate, terbinafine, and deferasirox. The company was formed in March 1996 through the merger of Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz. Sandoz, now a subsidiary of Novartis, focuses on generic pharmaceuticals and biosimilars.

['Microsoft Deutschland GmbH'].company_description: Microsoft Deutschland GmbH operates in the IT industry, offering software development services. The company is headquartered in Unterschleissheim, on the outskirts of Munich. Microsoft Cloud Germany is designed to meet strict German data protection requirements and includes a German data trustee, operating under German law, who controls physical and logical access to customer data. All customer data, and the systems that process or control access to customer data, reside in German data centers.
